issue.title: Helm lint fails at /properties/extraAnnotations
issue.body:
Hi. 
I'm getting this error from `helm lint`:

```
❯ helm lint .
==> Linting .
[ERROR] values.yaml: "file:///values.schema.json#" is not valid against metaschema: jsonschema validation failed with 'https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema#'
- at '': 'allOf' failed
  - at '/properties/extraAnnotations': 'allOf' failed
    - at '/properties/extraAnnotations/examples': got object, want array
[ERROR] templates/: values don't meet the specifications of the schema(s) in the following chart(s):
atlantis:
"file:///values.schema.json#" is not valid against metaschema: jsonschema validation failed with 'https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema#'
- at '': 'allOf' failed
  - at '/properties/extraAnnotations': 'allOf' failed
    - at '/properties/extraAnnotations/examples': got object, want array

Error: 1 chart(s) linted, 1 chart(s) failed
```

Looks like `extraAnnotations/examples` should be an array, not an object, to pass the validation against metachema.

body:
Same error for me, seen in helm 3.18.6 and 3.18.5.

While the 3.18.4 is working fine.

I dig into this subject and it was not easy to figure this out.

There is a [json library migration in 3.18.5](https://github.com/helm/helm/compare/v3.18.4...v3.18.5#diff-33ef32bf6c23acb95f5902d7097b7a1d5128ca061167ec0716715b0b9eeaa5f6R32) that means that json schema is stricker now. What I understand is 3.18.4 didn’t check external URNs unless validation walked into them (and/or they were preloaded).
3.18.5’s loader wiring made external $refs compile-time strict, exposing the missing urn handler.

It seems that URN handling for external reference is not easily possible. We have to use [`addResource`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6#Compiler.AddResource) in Go code to dynamicaly loading other related json files. Same-document URNs (schema has $id: urn:… and refs use urn:…#anchor) work without a loader; only external URNs need AddResource/loader.
I played with the cli tool of the new jsonschema lib and I was not able to trick the schema to use an external json expect using `--map` (see: https://github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/commit/ed65924244c7fad4784aebfafcad7aa1ece6d2c2)

While reading your comment (I don't know if you own this chart), it seems that the error is on an "example". Could it be removed completly? Few options:
- Remove reference
- Put it into the value.schema.json
- Point to the other json using ./file-location.json instead of an URN.

Stil I've made a pull request that we will follow the same behavior as before. Do not expose error when it can be resolve, instead add a warning.

issue.title: jsonschema: warn and ignore unresolved URN $ref to match v3.18.4

issue.body:
**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Fixes: https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/31170

- v3.18.5 switched jsonschema and began resolving external $ref at compile-time, exposing missing urn handling (“no URLLoader registered for urn:…”).
- Sor I added in this PR a urn scheme loader and pluggable URNResolver. If unresolved, log a warning and return a permissive true schema (back-compatibilty like in 3.18.4).

To properly deal with another json file, we could in another PR add the ability to import other schema. Similar function exist jsonschema cli as with `--map` (https://github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/commit/ed65924244c7fad4784aebfafcad7aa1ece6d2c2).

Tested using a small chart [issue-31170-0.1.0.tgz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22139344/issue-31170-0.1.0.tgz)
With this basic `value.schema.json`

```js
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "$ref": "urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true"
}
```

Before:
```sh
$ ./bin/helm lint ./testdata/charts/issue-31170
==> Linting ./testdata/charts/issue-31170
[INFO] Chart.yaml: icon is recommended
[ERROR] values.yaml: failing loading "urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true": no URLLoader registered for "urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true"
[ERROR] templates/: values don't meet the specifications of the schema(s) in the following chart(s):
issue-31170:
failing loading "urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true": no URLLoader registered for "urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true"

Error: 1 chart(s) linted, 1 chart(s) failed
```

After:
```
$ ./bin/helm lint ./testdata/charts/issue-31170                  
level=WARN msg="unresolved URN reference ignored; using permissive schema" urn=urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true
metadata: map[APIVersion:v2 Annotations:map[] AppVersion: Condition: Dependencies:[] Deprecated:false Description: Home: Icon: Keywords:[] KubeVersion: Maintainers:[] Name:issue-31170 Sources:[] Tags: Type: Version:0.1.0]
==> Linting ./testdata/charts/issue-31170
[INFO] Chart.yaml: icon is recommended

1 chart(s) linted, 0 chart(s) failed
```

Also template output
```sh
$ ./bin/helm template test ./testdata/charts/issue-31170
level=WARN msg="unresolved URN reference ignored; using permissive schema" urn=urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true
metadata: map[APIVersion:v2 Annotations:map[] AppVersion: Condition: Dependencies:[] Deprecated:false Description: Home: Icon: Keywords:[] KubeVersion: Maintainers:[] Name:issue-31170 Sources:[] Tags: Type: Version:0.1.0]
---
# Source: issue-31170/templates/cm.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: example
```

issue.body:
**What this PR does / why we need it**:

- v3.18.5 switched jsonschema and began resolving external $ref at compile-time, exposing missing urn handling (“no URLLoader registered for urn:…”).
- Add urn scheme loader and pluggable URNResolver. If unresolved, log a warning and return a permissive true schema (back-compat).
- Avoid having a duplicated warn logs when we load the schema twice on linting for example.

Close: #31170
Related: https://github.com/helm/helm/pull/31240

issue.title: Helm Controller fails during schema validation (no URLLoader registered) due to upstream Helm issue

labels.name: area/helm
labels.description: Helm related issues and pull requests

repository.name: helm-controller
repository.description: The GitOps Toolkit Helm reconciler, for declarative Helming

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

We are seeing failures in the Helm Controller when applying a HelmRelease. The error looks like this:

`failing loading "urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true": no URLLoader registered for "urn:example:helm:schemas:v1:helm-schema-validation-conditions:v1/helmSchemaValidation-true"`

This appears to be caused by an upstream Helm issue:

- Open issue: [helm/helm#31170](https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/31170)
- Fix PR: [helm/helm#31247](https://github.com/helm/helm/pull/31247)
- Target milestone: [3.19.1](https://github.com/helm/helm/milestone/164)

Could you please track this upstream fix and update the Helm version bundled in Flux once it’s released? This would ensure Helm Controller users don’t hit this schema validation failure.

Thanks!
